qualification: These profiles are independently executed local instruction-tuned models. They are not human reviewers. Repeating one profile is not a second reviewer. Models may still share error modes. gemma3:12b and qwen3.5:9b are excluded because that pair was the failed free-form oracle in the predecessor.
eligibility: A profile is eligible only if it returns ACCEPT_COMPLETE for every frozen calibration known-good and does not return ACCEPT_COMPLETE for any frozen hard calibration mutation. An unparsable response is not ACCEPT_COMPLETE.
